title: INTERNSHIP + FIXED-TERM CONTRACT - Data Scientist / AI Engineer
description: Design and production deployment of a generative AI platform: agentic RAG, business applications, automated model evaluation and observability.
missions: Design and production deployment of an agentic RAG (LLM agents with tool orchestration and memory) leveraging the heterogeneous document bases of the different departments.
Production deployment of Open WebUI as the access interface to models and assistants, with user and permission management.
Development and securing of robust APIs to integrate the platform with existing services.
Implementation of SSO-OAuth authentication and HTTPS hardening to ensure compliance and security in production.
Design of an application that automates document processing, centralises knowledge base management and now also handles user access and permissions.
Implementation of an automated evaluation system for the retriever and the generator (test sets, relevance and faithfulness metrics) to drive continuous improvement.
Platform instrumentation with Langfuse: LLM chain tracing, performance and cost tracking, and production observability.
Development and production deployment of an audio transcription application (speech to text) with automatic AI summarisation.
Development of web applications and interfaces for various use cases.
Managing the transition from POC to production and supporting business teams in experimenting with and validating prototypes.

title: INTERNSHIP - Data Analyst
description: Data analysis and modelling for optimising the deployment of SFR network antennas.
missions: Preparation and analysis of technical and geographical data related to network infrastructure.
Development of Machine Learning models to predict coverage and identify areas for improvement.
Analysis of the factors influencing antenna performance.
Creation of visualisations and maps to support network sizing and planning.
